description.zh: > 该参数已废弃，传入该参数不会生效。
description.en: > This parameter is no longer used and does not take effect.

description.zh: 命令ID。您可以通过接口[DescribeCommands](~~64843~~)查询所有可用的CommandId。
description.en: The command ID. You can call the [DescribeCommands](~~64843~~) operation to query all available command IDs.

description.zh: 命令描述。支持全字符集，长度不得超过512个字符。
description.en: The command description. The description supports all character sets and can be up to 512 characters in length.

description.zh: 脚本执行的引导程序。长度不能超过 1 KB。
description.en: The launcher for script execution. The value cannot exceed 1 KB in length.

description.zh: 命令名称。支持全字符集，长度不得超过128个字符。
description.en: The command name. The name supports all character sets and can be up to 128 characters in length.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the command. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 您创建的命令在ECS实例中执行时最大的超时时间，单位为秒。当无法在配置的时间内运行并完成您创建的命令时，会出现超时现象。超时后，会强制终止命令进程，即取消命令的PID。
description.en: The maximum timeout period for the command to be run on the instance. Unit: seconds. When a command cannot run within the specified time range, the command times out. Then, the command process is forcibly terminated by canceling the process ID (PID) of the command.

description.zh: 执行路径。长度不得超过200个字符。
description.en: The working directory of the command. The value can be up to 200 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs modify-command --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --command-id c-hz01272yr520000 --name test-CommandName --description This_is_description. --command-content echo --working-dir /home/ --timeout 120 --launcher python3_-u_ACS::ScriptFileName_Ext_.py --region cn-hangzhou
